x-scid: SCID in male children resulting from mutation of a gene that codes for a protein on the surface of T cells that allows them to develop a growth factor receptor
x-linked: relating to genes or characteristics or conditions carried on the X chromosome
x: the 24th letter of the Roman alphabet
the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system
x-radiation: electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target
obtaining images by the use of X rays
x-ray: electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target
a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays; used in medical diagnosis
take an x-ray of something or somebody
x-raying: obtaining images by the use of X rays
x-tail: an unconventional arrangement of the tail control surfaces that replaces the traditional fin and horizontal surfaces with four surfaces set in an X-shaped configuration when viewed from the front or rear of the aircraft.
An alternative to the fin-and-tailplane approach is provided by the V-tail and X-tail designs.
x-axis: the horizontal axis in a plane coordinate system
